text: While the Board of Directors adopted item PA18.4 - 2026 On-Street Parking Rate Changes at its previous meeting on March 11, 2026, there have been some concerns raised about on-street parking rates in Willowdale (Ward 18) by the local Councillor (see attached letter).

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Referred the item to the President, Toronto Parking Authority to review the request from Councillor Cheng for consideration in future budget years.
